goals.name: Mover Training App — Company-Wide Rollout + Driver-Training Port + Digital Training Handbook
goals.assessment: Back to Red — remeasured against pipeline pace and the team is well behind it. Only 65 of 254 movers (26%) are at or past today's line of 71 tasks; the green gate is 70% of movers (178 people) at 92 tasks by 10/23, so we're 113 movers short of where we need to be right now. Branch pace vs. the expected line: Tampa 63%, McKinney 47%, San Antonio 36%, Dallas 29%, South Austin 29%, Fort Worth 22%, Houston 18%, North Austin 16%, Garland 10%, Leander 10%. Next-week checkpoint: 70% of the team above 82 tasks to get back on a green track. Engagement is proven — this is now a pure pace problem, and the bottom branches (Garland, Leander, North Austin) are the drag.
blockers: 26% of movers at/past the 71-task line — 113 short of the 178 needed at 92 tasks by 10/23
Bottom branches dragging: Garland 10%, Leander 10%, North Austin 16%
Next-week checkpoint: 70% of the team above 82 tasks
